title: fix(plugin-security): permission refusals speak the caller's language, falling back to the workspace default (#32656, 2/2)
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-elon-musk"} -->
_Requested by **Elon** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01WedDzV26nniwxv7jC88B9D?thread=cmsg_01WedDzV26nniwxv7jC88B9DXuamRUC67fx2TTYrFfyuSH)_

Fixes #32656

Stacked on #33276 (PR 1 of 2, base branch). Retarget to `main` once #33276 merges. The claim on #32656 names this branch.

## Maintainer quick read

The refusals a permission admin or end user reads now come back in their language: request language, else workspace default, else English (ruling C on #32440). Codes, statuses and the diagnostic `message` are unchanged.

## What changes

- **plugin-security, packaged permission-set lock:** `PackagedPermissionSetLockedError` and `PackagedPermissionSetProvenanceUnknownError` compose `userMessage` from an 11-language text table on the caller's ladder (each code matched by `resolveBundleLocale`, the platform's one locale ladder), instead of static English. The gate reads the ladder from its context; `assertPermissionSetNotPackageDeclared` and both constructors take it as an optional last argument (no locales ⇒ the English text, byte-identical to before).
- **plugin-security, authz middleware:** `userFacingDenialMessage` / `fieldEditDenialMessage` take `[ctx.locale, ctx.workspaceLocale]` and render in the first that has text (a deployment `errors.<key>` override, else the built-in operation-message catalog); none ⇒ `en` as before. Field labels are translated in the language the sentence resolves to.
- **metadata-protocol (pass-through):** `MetadataAuthoringGateContext` gains optional `userTextLocales`; `runAuthoringGate` forwards the save request's `userTextLocales` (from #33276) to the type's gate. Checked: E1's open PR #33251 touches none of these files.

## Why

#32656 asks every `userMessage` producer to compose in the request locale with the declared fallback. #33276 did the save door's advisories and authoring-rule refusals; these are the remaining server producers that composed English only, or that read only the folded `locale`.

## Verification

- `packaged-permission-set-lock.test.ts`: zh-CN, ja-JP (request wins over workspace), `tlh`→zh-TW workspace fallback, `tlh`/`tlh` = unstated = English; code/status/diagnostic identical in every language; the provenance-unknown refusal in de-DE.
- `permission-denied-user-copy.test.ts`: de-DE request with zh-CN workspace ⇒ zh-CN sentence; ja-JP request wins; de-DE/de-DE ⇒ en.
- `mutation-listeners.test.ts`: the gate receives the stated locales (empty entries dropped) and no key when none are stated.
- `meta-save-user-text-locale.test.ts` (runtime, both `/meta` doors): the permission gate receives `['zh-CN','de']`, and `[]` with none.
- Local: `@objectstack/plugin-security` full suite 6610 passed; metadata-protocol / runtime targeted tests green; typecheck clean; test-source alias gate clean.

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

- [x] 8. Title, body and comments are in English.
- [x] The *Before Submitting* list in CONTRIBUTING.md is done.
